hook.text: Workers in open offices are interrupted every 11 minutes. It takes 25 minutes to return to the original task.

buildup.text: Ambient conversation is one of the worst focus killers. Your brain automatically tries to process nearby speech.

discovery.text: The irrelevant speech effect: hearing words forces language processing even when you try to ignore them.

twist.text: White noise or brown noise can mask speech. Steady noise is not distracting. Unpredictable speech patterns are.

climax.text: For deep focus, choose silence or steady noise. Avoid environments with variable, intelligible conversation.

punchline.text: Your brain parses speech automatically. Mask it or avoid it.

quiz.question: Why is ambient conversation particularly distracting?
options: It reminds you of social obligations
Your brain automatically processes nearby speech
Speaking voices are louder than other office noises
